content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD tide/surge boundary-condition module (MODULE TIDE_MODULE @L52, header comment L46, history 11/26/2019 Fengyan Shi L49; not preprocessor-guarded unlike SEDIMENT/SUBGRID). TIDE_INITIAL (L97-239): reads sponge width Iwidth_tide from keyword 'WaveMakerPointNum' (L116, default 30 L119), flags TIDAL_BC_ABS (L133, absorb-only) and TIDAL_BC_GEN_ABS (L149, generate+absorb); if either is on, reads TideBcType (L170, default 'CONSTANT') and dispatches Tide_READ_CONSTANT when TideBcType(1:4)=='CONS' (L184,L196) or Tide_READ_DATA_INIT when =='DATA' (L199,L211); allocates 4 sponge arrays (L214-215) and builds them via TIDE_SPONGE (L218); for absorb-only additionally calls REMOVE_SPONGE (L222-237). TIDE_SPONGE (L242-313): with Iwidth=Iwidth_tide (L251), lim=1.0 (L252), R_sp=0.85 (L253), A_sp=10.0 (L254) builds per-boundary relaxation fields SPONGE_TIDE_*(i,j)=max(A_sp**ri,lim) where ri=R_sp**(50*(distance)/(Iwidth-1)) using global index offsets in the PARALLEL branches (L261 west i+npx*Mglob/px-1, L273 east, L286 south, L298 north), then inverts all four: SPONGE_TIDE_*=1/SPONGE_TIDE_* (L306-309). TIDE_BC (L315-371): for each active boundary relaxes ETA/U/V toward tide values over the boundary strips (west I=1..Iwidth L325, east I=Mloc-Iwidth+1..Mloc L337, south J=1..Iwidth L348, north J=Nloc-Iwidth+1..Nloc L360) at MASK==1 points via X = TideBC + (X - TideBC)*SPONGE (L327-329 etc). Tide_READ_CONSTANT (L373-579): reads constant Tide{West,East,South,North}_{ETA,U,V} from input.txt (L390-576); missing _ETA disables that boundary (TideWest=.FALSE. L393 etc), missing _U/_V default ZERO. REMOVE_SPONGE (L582-663): zeroes Sponge_{west,east,south,north}_width (L592,L606,L620,L634) for active tide boundaries; if all boundaries inactive sets TIDAL_BC_ABS=.FALSE. (L649). Tide_READ_DATA_INIT (L665-849): reads per-boundary file names Tide{West,East,South,North}FileName (L682,L726,L767,L808; absent disables boundary), opens units 201/202/203/204 (L698-699,L740-741,L781-782,L822-823), reads a header line then first record Time,Eta,U,V (L700-701 etc) and copies level 2 to level 1 (L703-706 etc). TIDE_DATA (L851-1072): per boundary, when TIME passes both bracket times shifts level 2 to 1 (L862-865 etc) and reads records in DO WHILE(Time_2 < TIME+DT) with END=120 (L867-869, L921-923, L974-976, L1027-1029); computes linear interpolation weights tmp2=(Time_2-TIME)/MAX(SMALL,|Time_2-Time_1|), tmp1=1-tmp2 (L897-899 etc, zeroed when no more data) and sets TideWEST_U/V/ETA = X_2*tmp1+X_1*tmp2 (L904-906, east L957-959, south L1010-1012, north L1063-1065); label 120 CONTINUE at L1070 terminates the routine on any EOF.

io.name: DO WHILE record read west, END=120
DO WHILE record read east, END=120
DO WHILE record read south, END=120
DO WHILE record read north, END=120

verbatim_spans.text: !  TIDE_MODULE is a module to add tide/surge boundary conditions into wave simulation
Iwidth = Iwidth_tide ! specified in read or default = 30
! intel compiler does not work well with inquire, so change to ierr==1
WRITE(3,'(A80)')'You dont specify TideNorth_V, use default: 0'

unresolved: Cross-line bug: serial north sponge uses ri=R_sp**(50*(Nloc-i)/(Iwidth-1)) @L300 with loop index i, while the PARALLEL branch @L298 and the south/west analogues use the j distance - serial north sponge varies along x instead of y

Cross-line copy-paste bug: all-boundaries-off test @L647-648 checks (.NOT.TideWest).AND.(.NOT.TideEast).AND.(.NOT.TideEast).AND.(.NOT.TideEast) - TideSouth and TideNorth are never tested; additionally the parallel log message @L654 wrongly prints 'You dont specify TideNorth_V, use default: 0' where the serial branch prints 'You specify Tide but no BCs, set tide as false' @L657-658

Shared EOF label: END=120 in all four DO WHILE readers (L868,L922,L975,L1028) jumps to 120 CONTINUE @L1070 at the very end of TIDE_DATA, so EOF on the west file skips the east/south/north updates for that step (their interpolation continues next call with stale brackets)
REMOVE_SPONGE (zeroing Sponge_*_width) is called only under TIDAL_BC_ABS @L222-237, not for TIDAL_BC_GEN_ABS
Sponge exponent 50*(i-1)/(Iwidth-1) is integer arithmetic (i, Iwidth INTEGER) - exponent truncates to integer steps; sponge shape is stepwise
Comment @L965 'Ifile = 203  ! east' mislabels the south unit; module-scope Ifile @L84 is shadowed by locals @L108/L384/L676/L853

TideDataFileName @L69 declared but never used; Lstart,Lend @L249 unused; Iwidth is set from Iwidth_tide only in TIDE_SPONGE @L251 but TIDE_BC uses Iwidth (L325 etc) - if TIDE_SPONGE were skipped Iwidth would be undefined
Tide files are opened on units 201-204 in Tide_READ_DATA_INIT and stay open for sequential reading in TIDE_DATA across calls; header line consumed once @L700 etc
Case variants TideWEST_U (L904) and TideWest_U (L79) are the same case-insensitive variable

TIDE_BC boundary strips use local indices I=1..Iwidth etc on every rank; on interior ranks the sponge value is lim=1 (inverted to 1) making the relaxation a no-op by construction of the global-offset exponents
